countWeight keeps 0^0=1. Initial normalizer is one; zero prior atoms stay zero. positive_update derives positive next normalizer from positive current normalizer and actual positive receipt mass. No open-interval rate or strictly-positive atom assumption is added.
posteriorWeight uses the prior at a zero normalizer. Supported-update and conditional-history theorems establish a positive denominator before division, so the default does not manufacture support.
